name: Crossed Lines
source:
In a bustling college town, you navigate the ups and downs of university life—balancing friendships, academics, and romance. Conflicts arise with a charming but cruel rival. As emotions run high and secrets surface, every choice shapes your relationships and future. Will you hold everything together? The path is yours to decide.​

[From F95Zone]
